briefs.body:
# Market brief — Monday 2026-10-12 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Mon 2026-10-12**
- no major prints — Columbus Day (banks/bonds closed or thin liquidity; stocks open regular hours)

**Tue 2026-10-13**
- 06:00 ET — NFIB Small Business Optimism (Sep; cons. ~98 vs prior 98.7) — small-biz sentiment
- 10:00 ET — Existing Home Sales (Sep; cons. ~3.96m vs prior 3.98m) — housing activity

**Wed 2026-10-14**
- 08:30 ET — CPI / Core CPI (Sep; cons. ~3.6% y/y / 0.6% m/m headline, 2.5% / 0.2% core vs prior 3.4% / 0.4% and 2.4% / 0.3%) — inflation print
- 14:00 ET — Beige Book — regional Fed activity

**Thu 2026-10-15**
- 08:30 ET — PPI / Core PPI (Sep; cons. ~0.5% / 0.3% m/m) — wholesale inflation
- 08:30 ET — Retail Sales (Sep; cons. ~0.3% m/m) — consumer demand
- 08:30 ET — Initial Jobless Claims (week of Oct 10; prior ~197k) — labor check

**Fri 2026-10-16**
- Monthly equity OPEX — SPX AM-settled and equity/ETF options expire — gamma roll-off
- 08:30 ET — Import/Export Prices (Sep) — trade inflation
- 09:15 ET — Industrial Production / Capacity Utilization (Sep) — output

No ADP, NFP, FOMC decision, or GDP in this window. Next FOMC Oct 27–28. VIX expiration Oct 21.

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BlueBird 14–16 reported shipped to Cape Canaveral late September — inferred — company post; no SpaceX or company launch NET published in window.
**Window through Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification of consolidated USA-A application — estimated — administrative stage per company materials; not a dated Federal Register event.
**2026-10-16** — IWM / index options — monthly equity OPEX — confirmed.
**2026-10-21** — VIX — standard monthly VIX futures/options expiration — confirmed.
ASTS: no dated events found in 30d. Q3 earnings estimates around Nov 8–9 sit outside the window. Spectrum bidding process for Grain Management 800 MHz licenses targets completion by Nov 5 (outside or edge).
TMC: $11.50 public and private warrants expired 2026-09-09 and are not live. No new ISA, vessel/Allseas, Korea Zinc, or Project Crucible dated items inside 30d. Earnings estimates around Nov 12 outside.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
Lookback ~14 calendar days of reported Form 4 (filing date primary).

ASTS
- Wayne Thorsen, EVP & Chief Commercial Officer — RSU grant/award (code A, not open-market purchase) — 200,000 Class A at $0 — remaining direct 200,000 — txn 2026-09-28, filed 2026-10-01.
No open-market purchases or sales with filing date in the last ~14d. Prior Yao (CTO) 10b5-1 sale 40k @ ~$58.93 and Gupta (COO) sale 12k @ $58.89 were filed 2026-09-17 (outside strict window).

TMC
- Liam M. Mallon, Director — RSU grants (code A) — 25,445 on 2026-09-25 and 77,720 on 2026-09-28, totaling ~103k, at $0 — remaining direct 103,165 — filed 2026-10-09.
No open-market Form 4 purchase or sale in the last ~14d. Prior Hall RSU grant filed earlier.

## Rates and bonds
Cash Treasuries closed or thin for Columbus Day. Latest available (Oct 8–9 close): 10y ~5.22% (–6 bp on that session), 2y ~4.75% (–2 bp), 10y–2y spread ~+0.44 to +0.47 bp (not inverted). 5y TIPS real yield ~2.68% vs 5y nominal ~5.02%; 5y breakeven ~2.34%; 10y breakeven ~2.33%; 5y5y forward inflation ~2.32%. Growth data this week (CPI especially) can still move the path; real yields remain elevated while breakevens stay anchored near 2.3%.

## USD/JPY
Spot near 158.3 (recent range high ~158.5). Overnight mixed; short trend grinding higher toward 160 after mid-month dips. Verbal intervention chatter around 160 remains; BoJ next meeting Oct 29–30. US yields the dominant driver.

## Equities tape
SPX closed Friday 7,811.54 (+0.59%); futures mildly positive early (~+0.07–0.10%). NDX/QQQ closed ~30,853 / QQQ ~751 (near recent peak). IWM/Russell 2000 2,806.98 (+0.46%); about 8–9% under recent peaks. VIX closed ~14.84 Friday, early indications mid-15s — low-vol regime. Breadth details limited pre-open; equal-weight lagged recently on some sessions. ASTS premarket ~$52.31 (+2.6%).

## Names / themes only if material overnight
ASTS modest premarket bid; no new company headline or filing found overnight. TMC quiet. No critical-minerals or spectrum catalyst overnight.

## What actually matters this morning
- Quiet cash open on Columbus Day with thin rates liquidity; stocks open.
- Wednesday 08:30 September CPI as the week’s primary rates, USDJPY, and vol event.
- Thursday PPI + retail sales + claims as follow-through inflation/demand print.
- Friday monthly equity OPEX (and AM SPX settlement) for gamma dynamics.
- Watchlist: no dated ASTS launch or TMC process event today; windows only.
